title: Bodh Gaya, in stillness
intro: Time for worship, meditation and the sacred places around Bodh Gaya.

days.title: Bodhgaya
activities: Reach Gaya Airport by morning, afternoon & evening.
Pick up from airport and proceed to hotel.
Participate in the evening worship at the Mahabodhi Temple.
Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Bodhgaya
activities: Visit the Mahabodhi Mahavihara Temple and meditate under the bodhi tree.
Discover the surroundings and experience the majestic Great Buddha Statue.
Feel the peace of Mahakala Cave (Dungeshwari Hill).
Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Bodhgaya Morning, Afternoon Departure — A Time For Final Reflections.
activities: Visit the Sujata Temple and Stupa in the morning.
Depart from Bodhgaya with lasting memories of the Sanghapathways Tour India.

title: Sacred Bihar & Sarnath
intro: Connect Bodh Gaya, Rajgir and Nalanda with Sarnath and a sunrise on the Ganges.

days.title: Bodhgaya
activities: Reach Gaya Airport by morning, afternoon & evening.
Pick up from airport and proceed to hotel.
Check into hotel, rest and prepare for the spiritual journey ahead.
Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Bodhgaya
activities: Visit the Mahabodhi Mahavihara Temple and meditate under the bodhi tree.
Discover the surroundings and experience the majestic Great Buddha Statue.
Feel the peace of Mahakala Cave (Dungeshwari Hill) and Sujata Stupa.
Participate in the evening worship at the Mahabodhi Temple.
Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Rajgir – Nalanda – Bodhgaya
activities: Visit Gridhakuta Hill, Venuvan, Bimbisara Jail in Rajgir.
Continue to Nalanda and explore the ancient Nalanda University ruins along with its museum.
Return to Bodhgaya for an overnight stay.

days.title: Sarnath
activities: After breakfast, checkout from Bodhgaya and proceed to Sarnath.
Discover the historic Dhamek Stupa, Mulgandha Kuti Vihar, and Chaukhandi Stupa at Sarnath.
Explore the local markets of Sarnath.
Overnight stay in Sarnath.

days.title: Varanasi
activities: Experience a peaceful sunrise boat ride along the Ganges.
Depart from Varanasi with lasting memories of the Sanghapathways Tour India.

title: The Buddhist heritage trail
intro: A journey through sacred sites in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, returning to Bodh Gaya.

days.title: Bodhgaya
activities: Reach Gaya Airport by morning, afternoon & evening.
Pick up from airport and proceed to hotel.
Participate in the evening worship at the Mahabodhi Temple.
Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Bodhgaya
activities: Visit the Mahabodhi Mahavihara Temple and meditate under the bodhi tree.
Discover the surroundings and experience the majestic Great Buddha Statue.
Feel the peace of Mahakala Cave (Dungeshwari Hill).
Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Rajgir – Nalanda
activities: After breakfast, continue your pilgrimage from Bodhgaya to Rajgir and Nalanda.
Visit Venuvan, Bimbisara Jail, Gridhakuta Hill, Nalanda University ruins and museum in Rajgir and Nalanda.
Overnight stay in Rajgir.

days.title: Vaishali – Kushinagar
activities: Proceed to Kushinagar, stopping en route at Vaishali and the majestic Kesariya Buddha Stupa.
Explore the rich historical heritage of Vaishali.
Overnight stay in kushinagar.

days.title: Kushinagar – Sarnath
activities: Explore the Mahaparinirvana Temple and the Ramabhar Stupa in Kushinagar.
Travel to Sarnath, The Sacred Land of Buddha’s First Sermon.
Overnight stay in Sarnath.

days.title: Varanasi – Sarnath – Bodhgaya
activities: Experience a peaceful sunrise boat ride along the Ganges.
Discover the historic Dhamek Stupa, Mulgandha Kuti Vihar, and Chaukhandi Stupa at Sarnath.
Return to Bodhgaya for an overnight stay.

days.title: Bodhgaya Departure – A Spiritual Journey Remembered
activities: Visit the Sujata Temple and Stupa in the morning.
Depart Bodhgaya with a deeper sense of peace and lasting memories of the Sanghapathways Tour India.

title: Across the sacred lands
intro: From Varanasi to Lumbini, journey through the Buddhist circuit before a reflective finish in Bodh Gaya.

days.title: Varanasi
activities: Reach Varanasi Airport by morning, afternoon & evening.
Pick up from airport and proceed to hotel.
Attend the sacred Ganga Aarti held at the ghats during the evening.
Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Sarnath – Shravasti
activities: Discover the historic Dhamek Stupa, Mulgandha Kuti Vihar, and Chaukhandi Stupa at Sarnath.
Travel to Shravasti, a place of great spiritual significance.
Visit the major sites of Shravasti, including the Jetavana Monastery.
Overnight stay in Shravasti.

days.title: Shravasti – Lumbini
activities: Visit more places in Shravasti during the morning.
Proceed to Lumbini, the birth place of Lord Buddha.
Explore the Maya Devi Temple, the Ashoka Pillar, and the sacred gardens of Lumbini.
Overnight stay in Lumbini.

days.title: Lumbini – Kushinagar
activities: Travel to Kushinagar, explore the Mahaparinirvana Temple and the Ramabhar Stupa in Kushinagar.
Overnight stay in kushinagar.

days.title: Kushinagar – Vaishali – Rajgir
activities: On the way to Vaishali, visit the magnificent Kesariya Buddha Stupa.
Explore the historic landmarks of Vaishali, such as the Ananda Stupa and the Buddha Relic Stupa.
Continue your pilgrimage to Rajgir, where an overnight stay awaits.

days.title: Rajgir – Nalanda – Bodhgaya
activities: Visit Venuvan, Bimbisara Jail, Nalanda University and Gridhakuta Hill in Rajgir & Nalanda.
Reach the sacred land of Bodhgaya and enjoy a serene overnight stay.

days.title: Bodhgaya
activities: Discover the spiritual calm of Mahakala Cave (Dungeshwari Hill) and Sujata Stupa.
Discover the local attractions and marvel at the majestic Great Buddha Statue.
Experience the spiritual ambiance of the evening worship at the Mahabodhi Temple.
Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Bodhgaya Departure – A Spiritual Journey Remembered
activities: Visit the holy Mahabodhi Mahavihara Temple and reflect peacefully under the Bodhi Tree.
End your Bodhgaya visit with a heart full of memories from the Sanghapathways Tour India experience.
